comment: Answers of the Python programs that tasks of ops/ansible ran inline at revision dbfec38e, recorded before their removal by a scratch recorder that was never committed. Each test names how its program was run; every case is bound to the SHA-256 of its canonical JSON description (sorted keys, no blanks, UTF-8). programs names each program's playbook, task and the SHA-256 of its source text.

programs.task: Generate independent deployment secrets once without printing them

every_recorded_secret_file_state_is_answ.comment: The 'Generate independent deployment secrets once without printing them' program of ops/ansible/public.yml at dbfec38e, as recorded by a scratch recorder: each case's file state was built in a private directory and the program ran under the interpreter named here with only its fixed absolute paths replaced by that directory's and the owner and group it requires replaced (root is the recording user and group, other is not); a held lock was held by the recorder. Its exit status and output were kept; for a created file its mode, names and value shape, never a value. Each case is bound to the SHA-256 of its canonical JSON description.
